Unnamed: 1: 2014: Acquires Nokia phones for $9.5B. Satya replaces Ballmer.
2008: Acquires Aquantive for $8B, proposes to acquire Yahoo.
1991: MS-DOS 5.0. DOS was installed on 75% of all computers at that point (60m PCs)
1983: Microsoft Word for DOS released. Microsoft Flight Simulator. Microsoft Press founded.
1981: Converts from partnership to corporation. DOS released.

1980: Enters OS market with UNIX license "XENIX". IBM deal for MS-DOS. Releases "SoftCard", hardware product for Apple II. $8m revenue. BASIC for Atari in development. 86-QDOS created by Seattle Computer. Bob O'Rear. Marla Wood, Steve Wood left the company. Steve Ballmer joins in June as employee 30. 28 programmers, Gates and a secretary.

1979: Establishes consumer products division with Vern Raburn: Typing Tutor and Adventure. $4m revenue. Steve Smith joins in July, just before Raburn as Marketing Director. Xerox $150k customer. CBASIC from Digital became a competitor.
1977: Terminates MITS license agreement. FORTRAN, 6800, 6502 but not 8080 BASIC. MITS/Pertec litigation returns BASIC to Microsoft. COBOL released. Tandy & Apple sign BASIC deals.
1976: 4K, 8K, Extended, ROM and Disk BASIC. NCR and GE purchased BASIC. $200,000 revenue.
1975: Microsoft founded, signed MITS BASIC deal for $3,000 upfront, with royalties capped at $180,000.
